%c[ui_gray_2]COMPATIBILITY:
 
%c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] AK-12 Monolith.
 
 %c[ui_gray_1] This kit includes: an ergonomic forend that allows installation of a 30mm underbarrel grenade launcher, as well as sights for short and medium-long distances: Trijicon Acog and AN/PEQ-16 LAM. Also high capacity 60 round magazines set is included. This is irreversible upgrade.

This tactical kit includes combination of two scopes made by Belarusian BelOMO and US Leupold companies. The kit gives ability to install two scopes PSO-1M2-1 and Deltapoint PRO on rifles that have both dovetail and picatinny mounts. This setup allows shooter to use his rifle on short and long distances without any discomfort.
